import math

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    # Rx(pi/2) |0> = (|0> - i|1>)/sqrt2
    # S = diag(1,i) removes the -i phase on |1>
    # S Rx(pi/2) |0> = (|0> + |1>)/sqrt2 = |+>
    qc.rx(math.pi / 2, 0)
    qc.s(0)
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
import math

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    # H = i * Ry(pi/2) Rz(pi)  up to global phase
    # Rz(pi) |0> = -i |0>
    # Ry(pi/2) |0> = |+>
    # So Rz(pi) followed by Ry(pi/2) prepares |+> up to a global phase
    qc.rz(math.pi, 0)
    qc.ry(math.pi / 2, 0)
    return qc
